faults.detail: The record was executed on FRM-MF-101 v1.0. QA issued FRM-MF-101 v2.0 for this batch (see the issuance record), and v1.0 was superseded on 2026-08-17: the culture pH range it carries (6.8–7.4) was tightened to 6.9–7.3, and it does not designate independent verification of the filtration and fill step.
The batch summary states a final concentration of 14.0 mg/mL; the step 5 entry states 10.4 mg/mL. The summary does not match the record it summarizes.
The label specimen states a protein concentration of 14.0 mg/mL; the batch record states 10.4 mg/mL. Label content is taken from the batch record (WI-MF-001 §3).
